This beautiful remodeled home offers 2 spacious bedrooms, 1.5 Bath and a huge garage perfect for expanding and building another unit. Enjoy an amazing deck with breathtaking views of the ocean. Perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests.

Located in a desirable neighborhood, close to Westborough area, with its great restaurants and shopping. Short drive to Geary and Clement Streets, with easy access to Argonne Elementary School, UCSF, and the iconic Golden Gate Park. Enjoy natural light throughout, a funtional layout, and great potential in a desirable neighborhood. A fantastic opportunity to own a versatile space with extra room to grow! Dont miss out on this incredible opportunity!
